data.name: Tultul
data.gender_notes: Tultul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tultul is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Tulasi’ which means lotus. The lotus is considered a sacred symbol of purity and creation, and is often depicted in water. This name is believed to bring blessings of fertility and abundance. The name Tultul carries the meaning “Lotus in Water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tultul usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus in water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity, creation, and spiritual growth through overcoming challenges.
data.etymology: Tultul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus in Water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tultul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The lotus is also a fundamental aspect of Hinduism, representing purity, detachment, and rebirth, among other things. Tultul is a name deeply rooted in these rich cultural traditions.
